title: 10 Must-Try Pizza Combinations for Pizza Lovers
content: Pizza is more than just food — it's an emotion! If you're a true pizza lover, you'll know that the right combination of toppings can take your pizza experience to the next level. Here are 8 delicious pizza combinations you must try.

sections.title: Margherita + Fresh Basil
sections.heading: Classic Italian Pizza
sections.description: The classic combination of mozzarella, tomato sauce and fresh basil creates a fresh, delicious and comforting pizza.
sections.author: FoodZone
recipeSteps: Roll the pizza dough into a round shape.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese melts.
Remove the pizza from the oven and add fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve hot.
sections.aboutDish: Margherita pizza is a timeless Italian classic made with tomato sauce, mozzarella and fresh basil. The combination is simple but full of fresh and delicious flavors.
